content: Merikɨtsɨ 'ana niuki tuayamete yunaukame nekaniwaruxeiya, tatserieta, ta'utata, tahixɨapa, tatsutɨa naitsata 'etsikinatsie meti'utɨ 'eka mepɨkapitɨakai, naitsarie mɨka'uyeikanikɨ kwiepa, haramaratsie meta naime kɨyexitetsie.

Hikɨ xeime nekaniuxeiya niuki tuayame tau manatineika 'utimiekame, Kakaɨyari mayeniere tseyuya 'akwetɨ. Hikɨ karima kaniwarutahiwieni niuki tuayamete yunaukame, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ memɨtepitɨariekai 'axamemiyurienikɨ kwiepa meta haramara:
«'Akuxi 'axaxepɨka'iyurieka kwie, haramara meta naime kɨyexite, tekawatitseyumawekaku takakaɨyari te'uximayatametemama wakanata».

Hikɨ 'inɨarite nekaniu'enieni, kememɨyupaɨmekai memutseyumarie: Xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana nauka miriyari (144.000) meyupaɨmetɨ mekaniutseyumarieni 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama. Xexuitɨ nuiwarite mepuxuawekai.

Kura nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari mekaniutseyumarieni, Xuweni nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Kari nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari,
'Atseri nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Nepɨtahari nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Manatsexi nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari,
Tsimiyuni nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Rewi nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, 'Itsakaxi nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari,

Tsawuruni nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Kutse nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari, Wenikamini nuiwarieyatsie miemete tamamata heimana huta miriyari mekaniutseyumarieni.

Merikɨtsɨ 'ana nekaneutaniere, teɨteri yumɨireme nekaniwaruxeiya naitsarie kiekatari, nuiwarite, kiekari mukumanetsie meta kememɨte'uniukakai, tewi pɨkayɨwekai mɨwaruti'inɨatakɨ. Mana 'uweni hɨxie meta Muxa hɨxie mekaniti'ukaitɨni me'anakatuxatɨ, takɨ me'upitɨ.
Yunaitɨ niuki tuayamete mana mekaniti'ukaitɨni 'uweni 'aurie, 'ukirawetsixi wa'aurie, meta yunaukatɨ memayeneniere wa'aurie. Hikɨ mekaniutihɨxima'uni 'uweni hɨxie, Kakaɨyari nenewieri mekaniupitɨani
Merikɨtsɨ xewitɨ 'ukiratsi mɨpaɨ kanetiniuta'iwawiya: —Mɨkɨ memanakatuxa, ¿kehate mepɨyɨa, hakewa mepeyekɨ?
Ne mɨpaɨ nekatinita'eiya: —Neuxei, matsi 'ekɨ yapepɨtimate. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe:

content.text: Yu'ixuriki mekaniuti'ekwa, meta mekanitituriya Muxa Nunutsi mumierie xuriyayakɨ.
tukarikɨ meta tɨkarikɨ hetsiena mieme tukitana mekateni'uximayaka,
Karikɨ Muxa yu'uwenitsie 'akaitɨ mɨkɨ pɨwa'ɨwiyani muxatsi wahɨweme hepaɨ yɨanetɨ,
pɨwarewitɨkɨni naitsarie haixa mukunenieretsie mana meharetɨ memayenenierenikɨ,
meta Kakaɨyari naime wa'ukai kana'itiexɨamɨkɨ wahɨxita.
